notes.title: Update Information Dec 22, 2023
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "CUSTOM MECH WARS". The following updates have been made.

Update Information Dec 22, 2023
・Improved the following points
- When building units in the "Reserch Department", missing parts are now grayed out on the parts list.
- Fixed a bug that prevented some sounds from playing under certain conditions during multiplayer.
- Fixed a bug that caused some enemies to stop attacking when decoys or turrets were activated.
- Fixed a problem in which button guides and other information were not displayed correctly when using the Nintendo Switch Pro Controller.
- Changed the method of judging gamepad input when "Seam input" is enabled.
- Fixed other minor problems.

notes.title: Update Information Dec 14, 2023
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "CUSTOM MECH WARS". The following updates have been made.

Update Information Dec 14, 2023
・Improved the following points
- The "Variable Perspective speed" setting for camera and aiming has been improved so that it can be set to "OFF".
- Improved the game settings in the online lobby to allow chat settings.

・The following problems have been fixed
- Fixed a bug with the Abby voice in the DLC
- Fixed a problem in which the room list for online multiplayer was only partially displayed.
- Fixed a bug in the search string judgment when searching for rooms in online multiplayer.
- Fixed a bug that caused friend-only rooms and password-only rooms to be canceled after a mission was completed.
- Fixed a bug that caused invitations to be sent to friends when creating friends-only rooms on Steam.
- Fixed other minor problems.

We look forward to your continued support of "CUSTOM MECH WARS".
Team CMW

*↓The "Variable Perspective speed" setting for camera and aiming has been improved so that it can be set to "OFF".

notes.title: Plans for Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Custom Mech Wars.

We are currently working on a patch for the problems reported by our users, including problems related to online multiplayer, or investigating the cause of the problems.
We plan to update the software one by one, starting with those bugs for which the cause has been identified and are ready to be fixed.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but we would appreciate it if you could update to the latest version before playing the game.

We would appreciate it if you could report any problems to the following thread.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2328310/discussions/0/6252749165563847264/

Thank you for your continued support of CUSTOM MECH WARS.

Team CMW
